content.short: Bitquery is an API-first product company dedicated to powering and solving blockchain data problems.
content.description: Bitquery is a software suite that parses, indexes, and stores blockchain data in a unified, query-friendly format. It began with bloxy.info as an analytics explorer and Ethereum Mainnet APIs. Bitquery now delivers cross-chain products and services that work across multiple blockchains, offering market analysis, money flow tracking, Dex trading, decentralized finance analytics, and resources to support scientific research and data-driven studies.
